title: AI-Based Health Monitoring and Advisory System
summary: MUST proposes biosensor-based health monitoring and advice to support earlier detection and preventive care.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MUST describes a monitoring and advisory system intended to improve access to preventive healthcare. Further biosensors, more advanced models, and telecom partnerships are planned. The account reports no measurements of detection, treatment, or access outcomes.
purpose: Support early detection and personalized preventive-health advice.
system: AI-Based Health Monitoring and Advisory System

ratings.reason: Early diagnosis and preventive advice are proposed without a documented patient outcome.
Reducing urban-rural healthcare disparities is an objective, not a measured effect.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 21: AI-Based Health Monitoring and Advisory System

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A health-monitoring prototype targets preventive care
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
